name: Italy
summary: Unlike France, Italy has no official source of fictitious identifiers that also pass validation. The tax agency's FatturaPA examples use VAT numbers that fail the check digit, and the Treasury's NSO UBL order examples use real public bodies (MEF, Sogei, Consip). Partita IVA candidates built with a valid office code and check digit (e.g. 00000010587) were not found in VIES, but they have not yet been checked in the Agenzia delle Entrate "Verifica partita IVA" service, so they are not listed as usable values. No reserved fictional telephone range was found in AGCOM material: do not invent Italian numbers. There is no fictitious town or postcode (CAP), and no official open CAP dataset.

identifiers.name: Partita IVA
identifiers.format: 11 digits = 7-digit serial + 3-digit office code + Luhn check digit
identifiers.notes: Office code 001–100 (province, roughly the ISTAT province code, e.g. 058 Rome, 015 Milan, 001 Turin) or special codes 120, 121, 888, 999.

identifiers.name: VAT number (EN 16931 / UBL)
identifiers.notes: A number missing from VIES may still be a purely domestic Partita IVA; the national check is the Verifica partita IVA service.

identifiers.name: Codice fiscale (company)
identifiers.format: Same 11 digits as the Partita IVA

identifiers.name: Codice fiscale (person)
identifiers.format: 16 characters = surname + name + birth date/sex + birthplace code + check letter
identifiers.notes: No validator yet. No official fictitious personal codice fiscale exists.

identifiers.name: IPA office code (Codice Univoco Ufficio)
identifiers.notes: Public bodies only. Listed in the IndicePA open data.

identifiers.name: CodiceDestinatario (SDI recipient code)
identifiers.notes: Routing code of the national FatturaPA exchange system (not UBL).

identifiers.name: REA number
identifiers.notes: Chamber of Commerce economic and administrative register.
